name: Asinan Betawi
desc: A harmonious blend of sweet, sour, and nutty flavors. Crisp vegetables and fruits mingle with a zesty tamarind dressing, topped with crushed peanuts for a delightful crunch.

name: Gado-Gado
desc: A delightful texture dance. Crisp vegetables, tofu, and tempeh embrace a creamy peanut sauce infused with tamarind and chili's vibrant notes.

name: Kupat Tahu Magelang
desc: Embrace the medley of textures. Steamed rice cake and silky tofu meet a rich peanut sauce, enriched with a sprinkle of sprouts and herbs.

name: Laksa Medan
desc: A feast for your senses. Creamy coconut broth, noodles, and a harmonious blend of toppings. Laksa Medan takes you on a flavor-packed journey.

name: Mie Kocok Bandung
desc: Savor the symphony of tender beef, chewy noodles, and aromatic herbs in a savory broth. A taste that lingers long after each spoonful.

name: Nasi Betutu
desc: Unwrap Bali's traditions. Slow-cooked chicken or duck wrapped in fragrant spices, delivers a tender taste of the island's heart.

name: Nasi Gudeg
desc: Unlock Java's heart with sweetly stewed young jackfruit. A fragrant blend of coconut milk, palm sugar, and spices weaves a captivating tale of flavors.

name: Nasi Liwet
desc: Relish the fragrant embrace of coconut-milk-infused rice, tender chicken, egg, and a medley of herbs and spices. Nasi Liwet is pure Indonesian comfort.

name: Nasi Pecel
desc: Indulge in a burst of colors and tastes. Crisp veggies adorned with a bold peanut sauce, kissed by kaffir lime leaves and a hint of spice.

name: Nasi Tutug Oncom
desc: Savor West Java's flavors. Warm rice and oncom (fermented soybean) mingle, accentuated by savory spices. A taste that speaks of tradition and love.

name: Nasi Uduk
desc: Delight in fragrant Nasi Uduk. Coconut-milk-infused rice, pandan leaves, and a parade of tempting sides. An ode to Indonesia's culinary artistry.

name: Soto Ayam
desc: Warmth in every sip. Soto Ayam delights with its fragrant chicken broth, vermicelli, and the invigorating touch of lemongrass and lime.

name: Soto Betawi
desc: Warm your soul with rich coconut broth, tender beef, and fragrant spices. A bowl of Soto Betawi captures Jakarta's essence in every spoonful.

name: Nasi Timbel
desc: A whole food meal from Sundanese consisting of Sayur Asem, sambal, ungkep kampong chicken, and organic rice wrapped with banana leaves.

name: Asinan Bogor
desc: A harmonious blend of sweet, sour, and nutty flavors. Crisp vegetables and fruits mingle with a zesty tamarind dressing, topped with crushed peanuts for a delightful crunch.

name: Batagor
desc: Batagor beckons with its magic. Crunchy fried dumplings, filled with fish and chicken, served with a nutty peanut sauce.

name: Bika Ambon
desc: Indulge in Bika Ambon's allure. A sweet blend of tapioca and coconut milk, graced with a touch of pandan. Its honeycomb texture and pandan aroma enchant with every bite.

name: Bubur
desc: Comfort in a bowl. Bubur delights with its warm embrace of rice porridge, accompanied by a medley of toppings and a sprinkle of crispy shallots.

name: Combro
desc: Savor the thrill of Combro. Cassava and corn fritters, crisp outside and soft inside, kissed by aromatic spices for an irresistible taste.

name: Jajan Pasar
desc: Delight in Jajan Pasar's treasures. Assorted traditional sweets showcase Indonesia's culinary heritage, embodying flavors that enchant generations.

name: Kue Lumpang Pandan
desc: Explore Kue Lumpang Pandan's charm. Coconut and pandan-infused rice cakes, layered with fragrant palm sugar. A dessert that captivates with every layer.

name: Lumpia
desc: Crisp and delightful Lumpia await. Golden-fried spring rolls embrace a medley of veggies and sometimes meat, promising a harmonious blend of flavors.

name: Lopis Ketan
desc: A festival favorite. Chewy savory glutinous rice cakes infused with palm sugar, coated in coconut flakes, and a hint of aromatic pandan. Perfect for celebrations or everyday snacks.

name: Pempek Palembang
desc: Dive into Pempek Palembang—a symphony of fish, sago, and spices. The perfect harmony of textures, served with a tangy tamarind sauce.

name: Rujak Buah
desc: A dance of tastes. A mix of tropical fruits, drizzled with a spicy palm sugar dressing and topped with crushed peanuts.

name: Serabi Petulo
desc: A blend of coconut and rice flour, graced by palm sugar. Fragrant pandan leaves enhance its enchanting taste.

name: Siomay Bandung
desc: Elevate your senses with Siomay Bandung. Steamed fish and shrimp dumplings, crowned with peanut sauce and a dash of zesty lime. A taste sensation awaits.

name: Tahu Gejrot
desc: Revel in Tahu Gejrot's excitement. Deep-fried tofu, tangy-spicy sauce, and a sprinkle of shallots create an explosion of taste and texture.

name: Ayam Bakar
desc: Succulent grilled chicken glazed with honey goodness. Marinated to perfection, this dish boasts a harmonious blend of sweet, smoky, and savory flavors that ignite your taste buds.

name: Ayam Betutu
desc: Unveil the magic of Ayam Betutu. Chicken marinated with a blend of spices, wrapped in banana leaves and slow-cooked until tender. A flavorful journey for your palate.

name: Ayam Goreng
desc: Crispy perfection awaits with our Ayam Goreng. Golden-fried chicken infused with aromatic spices for an explosion of taste and crunch in every bite.

name: Iga Penyet
desc: Savor the succulence of Iga Penyet. Crispy fried ribs, lovingly smashed and served with sambal, deliver a fiery kick of flavor.

name: Ikan Goreng
desc: Dive into the crispy world of Ikan Goreng. Our golden-fried fish is seasoned with a blend of spices, creating a delightful harmony of textures and flavors.

name: Ikan Sambal Dabu
desc: A fiery delight of Ikan Sambal Dabu. Fish dressed in vibrant chili sambal, enriched with Dabu-Dabu, a tangy mix of herbs and spices.

name: Pampis Cakalang
desc: Experience the richness of Pampis Cakalang. Tender shredded tuna, seasoned and slow-cooked to perfection. A flavor journey that captures the essence of Indonesia.

name: Pepes Ikan
desc: Unwrap the secret of Pepes Ikan. Fish, fragrant herbs, and spices cocooned in banana leaves, resulting in a tender, aromatic masterpiece.

name: Pepes Tahu
desc: Delight in Pepes Tahu. Soft tofu, aromatic herbs, and spices wrapped in banana leaves, create a fragrant, steamed treasure trove of taste.

name: Rendang
desc: Experience the legend of Rendang. Slow-cooked beef infused with a rich blend of coconut milk and spices, creates a symphony of flavors that's pure delight.

name: Sate Ayam
desc: Embark on a culinary adventure with Sate Ayam. Skewered, grilled chicken marinated in a tantalizing blend of spices served with a rich peanut sauce.

name: Sate Lilit
desc: Sate Lilit, is a culinary gem. Minced fish and aromatic spices molded onto lemongrass sticks, grilled to perfection, and served with a tantalizing sauce.

name: Tahu Goreng
desc: Crispy meets creamy in Tahu Goreng. Golden-fried tofu served with a zesty chili sauce. A taste sensation that's both satisfying and refreshing.

name: Tempe Orek
desc: Tempe Orek beckons with its sweet and savory allure. Tempeh, cooked to perfection with a medley of spices, offers a delightful textural and flavor contrast.

name: Lalapan
desc: Organic veggies meet savory sambal. Dive into our Lalapan featuring crisp cucumbers, tangy tomatoes, and spicy chili paste. A refreshing delight for your senses.

name: Tumis Oncom Leunca
desc: Savory oncom "fermented soy cake" and crunchy leunca "black nightshade" stir-fried with garlic, chili, and a medley of spices. A satisfying umami explosion.

name: Sayur Asem
desc: A vibrant medley of chayote, long beans, and corn, balanced by tangy tamarind and sweet palm sugar. A symphony of flavors awaits.

name: Sayur Bayem
desc: A delicate dance of spinach, carrot, and sponge gourd in a soothing broth. Enlivened by finger root, kemangi, and a subtle sweet-sour symphony. Pure comfort in every spoonful.

name: Sayur Lodeh
desc: Creamy coconut broth embraces tender veggies—green beans, cabbage, and tofu. A blend of flavors that's rich, soothing, and utterly satisfying.

name: Sayur Pecel
desc: Dive into a plate of mixed organic veggies drizzled with the irresistible flavors of cashew sauce. A tantalizing harmony of crunch and creaminess.

name: Soup
desc: A bowl of comfort awaits. Enjoy a medley of fresh vegetables in a light, flavorful broth. Nutrient-rich goodness that warms your soul.

name: Tumis Bunga Pepeaya
desc: Papaya blossoms stir-fried to perfection with a medley of aromatics. Savory, tender, and utterly captivating on your palate.

name: Bandrek
desc: A warm embrace of ginger, palm sugar, and spices. Comfort in every sip, perfect for cozy moments.

name: Es Campur
desc: A delightful mix of fruits, jellies, and syrups. Every spoonful reveals surprises—cool, colorful, and simply irresistible.

name: Es Cendol Dawet
desc: Tropical paradise in a glass. Avocado, jackfruit, and coconut meat, drenched in sweet syrup. A harmony of richness and freshness.

name: Es Cincau
desc: Dive into the magic of green grass jelly, melded with coconut milk and a touch of palm sugar. A cool classic that's pure enchantment.

name: Es Kuwut Bali
desc: A tropical symphony in a glass. Shredded young coconut, refreshing melon, crisp cucumber, zesty lime, and fragrant selasih and mint. A sweet and tangy sensation with delightful textures, capturing the essence of Bali.

name: Es Puter
desc: Creamy coconut ice cream, a taste of pure indulgence. Treat yourself to the smooth sensation of Es Puter, a dessert that's simply irresistible.

name: Es Teler
desc: Tropical paradise in a glass. Avocado, jackfruit, and coconut meat, drenched in sweet syrup. A harmony of richness and freshness.

name: Nasi Bancaan
desc: A festival of flavors on one plate. Nutty brown/red rice accompanied by aromatic rempah, grilled chicken/fish, curry tofu and tempe, and a fiery sambal. A celebration of Indonesia's culinary artistry.

name: Nasi Kuning
desc: A golden tribute to tradition. Turmeric-infused rice, caramelized tempe, coconut oil-fried chicken, serundeng, and sambal. A harmonious feast that embodies the spirit of festivities in every bite.
